item.title: Agentic AI Orchestration Layer
item.description: Custom agentic orchestration layer bridging Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenCode, and Codex—unified interface for multi-agent code generation and autonomous task execution. Demonstrates deep understanding of SOTA agentic systems, tool integration, and multi-LLM coordination.

item.title: Algorithmic Investment Platform & ArXiv Research Infrastructure
item.description: End-to-end personal investment platform with PostgreSQL data ingestion, Dask-based analysis cluster, and ArXiv paper research integration. 40GB VRAM, 5TB SSD, 22-core homelab infrastructure managing multi-source market data and algorithmic strategy research.

item.title: Generative AI Studio: ComfyUI & Open-WebUI Orchestration
item.description: Self-hosted generative AI orchestration platform integrating ComfyUI for advanced image generation workflows with Open-WebUI for unified multi-model LLM access. Demonstrates cutting-edge SOTA in generative AI infrastructure, real-time workflow execution, and model management at scale.

item.title: Music Embeddings & Clustering
item.description: Interactive music clustering visualization using embeddings to discover relationships between songs across genres. Combines dimensionality reduction (t-SNE, UMAP) with music feature extraction to create intuitive, explorable music graphs showing genre relationships, artist connections, and similarity clusters.

item.title: Domain-Specific RAG Pipeline & NLP Modernization - Boeing
item.description: Engineered production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and modernized Named Entity Recognition architecture for aerospace maintenance systems. Delivered domain-specific semantic layer supporting 150+ operations analysts with significant cycle time and cost reductions.

item.title: Automated Graph Ontologies from Text
item.description: Automatically extract and build interconnected knowledge graphs from unstructured text using a dual-model architecture combining entity extraction with predicate identification. Converts dense academic abstracts and technical documents into queryable semantic networks for enhanced RAG systems.

item.title: NLP Model Optimization & A/B Testing - Vennify
item.description: Conducted comprehensive A/B testing of NLP deployment optimizations, achieving significant latency improvements and cost reductions. Engineered dynamic programming batching solution that reduced training time by 30% while maintaining model accuracy.

item.title: Chess AI with Deep Q-Learning & Russian Doll MCTS
item.description: RL-based chess engine using Deep Q-Networks with progressive Monte Carlo Tree Search. Combines value-based learning with tree search for strategic decision-making.

item.title: Unified Authentication & Infrastructure Modernization - Boeing
item.description: Engineered unified authentication system across Windows and Linux infrastructure for aerospace contractor, ensuring DFARS/NIST compliance. Designed scalable infrastructure modernization supporting 500+ users and enabling secure access to sensitive DoD systems.
